items.information: # This competition has been cancelled. # The date for this competition has changed to August 20-21, 2021. Please familiarize yourself with the [Safety Plan] (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1vgSyWUwrL1MkixikzJqiZXodSBejV2S39T_18PCm5-E/edit). 1. If COVID-19 cases drop to below 10 cases / 100,000 residents within two weeks of the competition, the competition will continue as announced. 2. If COVID-19 cases are between 10 and 20 cases / 100,000 residents within two weeks of the competition, the competition will continue, but all attendees (spectators and competitors) must show either proof of full vaccination (2 weeks since last shot of 1 or 2 dose series) or have a negative COVID-19 test within 96 hours of the beginning of the event, or after 8:00am Eastern on Monday, August 16th, 2021. There are no exceptions. 3. If COVID-19 cases are greater than 20 cases / 100,000 residents within two weeks of the competition, the competition will not continue and we will either reschedule or cancel at that time. # Maximum one spectator per competitor. ## This competition’s registration and waitlist is full. We are very excited to announce the inaugural Pennsylvania Championship! Join us for a very sweet weekend of cubing and fun in historic Hershey Pennsylvania. We will have two special unofficial events as well as the option to have a day at HersheyPark on Sunday with all of your friends. This is the state championship for Pennsylvania, however, anyone can attend. All state champion titles are unofficial and are **not** recognized by the World Cube Association or CubingUSA. For more information on state champion eligibility, see the [PA Title eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PennsylvaniaChampionship2021#14358-pa-title-eligibility). This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations Live results can be found on our WCA Live page, which will be available during the competition. Before registering, you must read the "Competitor Information" tab. This tab details the responsibilites of all competitors at this competition. Day 1 Events: Pyraminx, Clock, Megaminx, 3x3 Blindfolded, 6x6, 7x7, Sq-1, FMC Day 2 Events: 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 3x3 One Handed **This competition is sponsored by TheCubicle!** Visit the [Sponsor/Vending](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PennsylvaniaChampionship2021#14359-sponsor-vending) tab for more information.

items.information: NZ North Island Championship 2021 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, NZ North Island Championship 2021 is the second regional championship held in New Zealand in the lead up to Nationals later in 2021.

venue.address: Memorial Union Building, 1400 Townsend Dr, Houghton, MI 49931

items.information: This is the fourth Copper Country Cubing competition, and we're looking forward to welcoming you to the Michigan Upper Peninsula! It's been a long time since anyone has been able to compete, so this event features two long events on Saturday evening and the more common NxN events on Sunday. We plan to host another competition this Fall with more of the non-NxN puzzles, so look out for it! As this competition takes place on the Michigan Technology University campus, it is subject to Michigan state laws, University campus policies, and WCA policies. We will monitor all of these sources for any changes to safety protocols and requirements. Please note that if community or regional health problems surface again or severely worsen, the competition may be forced to cancel. There is a 40 person Competitor Limit for this competition. Please sign up early to ensure a spot, and please read the "Waiting List" tab for additional information on registration for the competition. If the competition is running ahead of schedule and has enough competitors we would love to add an additional round to 3BLD, 3OH, and/or 6x6. Additionally, please note that the rounds are scheduled with more time than usual to account for stationary groups and sanitation time. **YOU MUST READ THE COVID SAFETY TAB PRIOR TO REGISTERING.**

items.information: Southern Scramble Dunedin 2021 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.information: Wellington Mind Games 2021 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. It is focused on some of the more mentally demanding events, that are given less of a focus in normal competitions - blindfolded and fewest moves solving, specifically. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience or skill. There will also be event-based time limits in place, to ensure we stay on schedule, especially given the time taken by fewest moves solving. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. **The main event of this competition is Fewest Moves**

items.information: #### Рубик шооны Монгол улсын аварга шалгаруулах албан ёсны нээллтэй тэмцээн This competition is the official Championship of Mongolia. English: The Bisiesto Open 2020 competition will be the fourth edition that will take place in this venue. Read the [regulations of the WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid possible issues. This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. Guests do not have to pay any type of entry or registration. Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the regulations. items.information: 2019 ist das Jahr in dem Speedcubing Competitions den Westen Österreichs erreichen. Nach Vorarlberg gibt es nun auch eine in Tirol! Durch Tirol zieht sich ein langes Tal, das Inntal, welches das breiteste Tal in Tirol ist, für erste Besucher aber trotzdem eng erscheinen könnte. Das Organisationsteam organisiert auch Räume in einer Jugendherberge im Nachbargebäude. Bei Interesse, wirf bitte eine Blick in den Travel/Accomodation Tab! ______ 2019 is the year that Competitions start spreading to the west of Austria. After Vorarlberg, we are happy to announce the first ever Competition in Tirol! Tirol is entirely mountainous with one big valley (the Inn Valley) stretching its entire length. This valley is big for tyrolean standards but for first-time visitors it might just seem tight as well. The organisation team is also organising Rooms in a youth hostel next door. If you are interested in this, take a look at the Travel/Accomodation tab!

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2019 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2019 will crown the National Champions in all 18 official events, over the course of 3 days.

items.information: **ESPAÑOL** Nuevamente el Palacio de la Juventud y la Municipalidad de Los Olivos nos brindarán su apoyo para llevar a cabo este torneo de speedsolving. Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA. Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la [pestaña “Horario" (Schedule)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la [pestaña “Categorías” (Events)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-events). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. **ENGLISH** Once again Palacio de la Juventud and Municipalidad de Los Olivos are supporting another speedsolving competition. The results of this competition will be listed on the WCA world rankings and new competitors will get an official WCA profile. For that reason, each competitor must be familiar with and understand the WCA Regulations before the competition. Each competitor must carefully choose the events in which he/she will participate after having seen the [Schedule tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-schedule). Please pay attention to the formats of each round and its respective time limits and cutoffs detailed at the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-events). It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

items.information: Vous n'êtes pas obligé d'arriver au moment de l'enregistrement, nous vous accepterons sans aucun problème si vous arrivez dans la journée. Essayez simplement d'être là au moins 30 minutes avant votre première épreuve. Une pièce d'identité vous sera demandée si c'est votre première compétition. **Merci de nous prévenir par e-mail si finalement vous ne pouvez pas participer à la compétition.** **REPAS** : Les samedi soir et dimanche soir, nous vous proposons un repas collectif et des jeux, sur le lieu de la compétition. Samedi soir, pour 10€ : * Des diots (saucisse de porc Savoyarde) et des crozets (une alternative végétarienne/végétalienne devrait être disponible, merci de nous le préciser) * Un dessert, incluant des gourdes de compote de pomme ou des fruits, un yaourt et peut-être un gateau Dimanche soir pour 15€ : * Une grande pizza (au choix, commande le jour J) * Un dessert, comme le samedi **LASER GAME** : Le samedi soir, nous allons au Laser Game ensemble, nous arrangerons les voitures avec les personnes présentes. Nous avons la grande salle, de 21h50 à minuit pour 2 parties de 45 minutes. Vous pouvez participer aux deux pour 28€ (à régler au Laser Game) ou une pour 15€. Merci de préciser dans la section "Commentaire" de votre inscription si vous comptez venir, et si vous êtes accompagnés, car il y a un nombre limité de places ! --- You are not obliged to be here at registration time, we will accept you if you come during the day. Try to be here at least 30 minutes before your first event. We'll ask for an ID if it's your first competition. **Please send us an email if you cannot participate after all.** **DINNERS**: On Saturday and Sunday evening, we propose a dinner all together, and games, at the competition venue. Saturday evening for 10€: * "Diots" (Savoyarde pork saussage) et "crozets" (a bit like pasta) (a vegetarian/vegan alternative should be availble, please ask us) * A dessert, including an apple jam or fruits, a yogurt and maybe a cake Sunday evening for 15€: * A big pizza (to be chosen on the day) * A dessert, like on Saturday **LASER GAME**: On saturday night we will go to play Laser Game together, we'll arrange shuttles with the cars available. We will have the main room from 21h50 to midnight for two 45 minute games. You can play in both for 28€ (to pay at the Laser Game) or one for 15€. Please mention in the "Comment" section of your registration to the competition if you're coming and if you are alone or with guests. There are limited spots!

items.information: This will be the second Copper Country Cubing (Michigan Technological University) competition, in Michigan's great Upper Peninsula. The Memorial Union Building (MUB) is located between the middle and west end of the Michigan Tech campus. Check the schedule to see if the events at that time will be in the second floor ballroom, first floor alumni lounge, or ground floor commons. We are excited to be bringing all 18 official WCA events to the area, which doesn't get many competitions. The first CCC competition had only 8 events and 23 competitors, so this time we're making it bigger and better! Friday is reserved for big BLD and feet, so you can arrive just for Saturday and Sunday if you aren't interested in that subset of events.

items.name: UK Championship 2019
items.information: Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. **Qualification Requirements**: If you do not meet the qualification requirements in competition *before* 11 October 2019, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the [Qualification tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UKChampionship2019#9139-qualification) to see all times required. **Final Round Advancements**: For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 3x3x3 with Feet - 4 UK competitors; 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3x3 Cube - 8 UK competitors. **Please Note**: As this is the UK Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

Só ganha quem estiver presente e ninguém pode ganhar duas vezes; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

Han pasado casi 8 años desde el primer Reto Chignahuapan, es hora de traer uno nuevo y no hay otra mejor manera que con un gran torneo. Este torneo es posible gracias al staff del ***Puebla Rubik’s Team*** y al ***Gobierno municipal de Chignahuapan.*** ![](https://i.imgur.com/17KskVW.jpg) Chignahuapan, *pueblo magico*, is the main manufacturer of Christmas spheres in Mexico. Chignahuapan is beautiful because its folklore and its natural landscapes are amazing. 8 years have passed since the first *Reto Chignahuapan*, it's time to bring a new one but in shape of 2019 This tournament is supported to ***Puebla Rubik's Team*** staff and ***Chignahuapan municipal government***

items.information: **ESPAÑOL** Navojoa, Sonora mejor conocida como La Perla del Mayo, es una bonita ciudad ubicada en el Sur de Sonora, rodeada de Sierra, Mar y Desierto. La tribu Mayo habita el sur de Sonora desde hace cientos de años, entre sus tradiciones mas destacadas podemos mencionar la danza del venado que es conocida a nivel internacional. La competencia del **Open del Mayo 2019** se desarrollara en el **CAS del Instituto Tecnologico de Sonora** principal universidad de la region, que cuenta con comodas instalaciones que permitiran a los participantes dar sus mejores tiempos. A menos de una hora de Navojoa se encuentra la playa de Huatabampito, El pueblo magico de Alamos y una gran variedad de atracciones turisticas de tipo rural. **INGLES** Navojoa, Sonora better known as the Pearl of May, is a beautiful city located in the South of Sonora, surrounded by Sierra, Sea and Desert. The Mayo tribe inhabits southern Sonora for hundreds of years, among its most outstanding traditions we can mention the deer dance that is known internationally. The competition del **Open del Mayo 2019** will be held at the **CAS of the Instituto Tecnologico de Sonora**, the main university in the region, which has comfortable facilities that will allow participants to give their best times. Less than an hour from Navojoa is the beach of Huatabampito, the magical town of Alamos and a wide variety of tourist attractions of a rural type. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbEVCIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--002a6631cf7fd8fb5b95574a60b59d2f48be6794/Display%20rubik%20del%20mayo.jpg2.jpg)

items.information: Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna auto-sustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Aiming to a good fluence for the competition, at registering for a event, you compromise to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in the other you'll help as staff.

Registration fee covers the cost of the organization and venue rental. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia. items.information: Летние соревнования будут проводиться на открытом воздухе на территории жилого комплекса возле Школы спидкубинга. Будут расставлены шатры защищающие участников от солнца и дождя. На соревнования необходимо взять с собой солнцезащитный крем и головоломки, которые вы будете собирать. На территории есть детская площадка и футбольное поле, где можно будет поиграть (мячи не предоставляем). Официальная церемония открытия состоится 20 июля 2019 года в 10:15. За участие всем будут выданы крутые памятные медали, а за призовые места во всех дисциплинах предусмотрены призы и медали! Summer competitions will be held outdoors in a residential complex near the School of speedcubing. Tents will be placed to protect participants from the sun and rain. Please take with you sunscreen and puzzles that you are going to solve. Onsite there is a children playground and a football field where you can play (balls are not provided) The official opening ceremony will take place on 20 July 2019 at 10:15. For participation everyone will be given a cool commemorative medals and for taking a podium of every event there are prizes and medals!

items.information: Following the first competition in Oceania (New Zealand Championships 2009), speedcubing exploded in popularity across the continent. Now, ten years later, we're holding a competition to celebrate the growth of the community, and everything we've achieved over that period. Oceania 10th Anniversary 2019 returns to Wellington, the site of that first competition, and marks almost exactly ten years since then. Additionally, this is the first competition of the "Cubing Down Under Tour" - a tightly scheduled series of competitions across Oceania, leading up to WCA World Championship 2019, in Melbourne. This should build hype for the World Championship, and, (especially for foreign competitors) provide an excellent opportunity to experience more of the continent. For more information, visit the [travel page](https://wc2019.speedcubing.org.au/en/travel) of the World Championship website.

items.information: **ESPAÑOL** Este es el primer torneo patrocinado por y realizado con la ayuda de Black Horse Toys. Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA. REGISTRO: El registro se considera completo cuando se ha completado el registro electrónico y se ha realizado el pago (precio y métodos de pago explicados en la sección de requisitos de registro). Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la pestaña “Horario" (Schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la pestaña “Categorías” (Events). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. *Los competidores que vengan de fuera de Lima deberán comunicarse y coordinar la forma de pago directamente con el organizador El registro permanecerá abierto hasta el viernes 31 de mayo o hasta que se alcance el límite de competidores. **ENGLISH** This is the first competition sponsored by Black Horse Toys store. The results of this competition will be listed on the WCA world rankings and new competitors will get an official WCA profile. For that reason, each competitor must be familiar with and understand the WCA Regulations before the competition. REGISTRATION: A register is considered complete when electronic registration has been completed and payment has been made (registration fees and payment methods are detailed at Registration requirements section). Each competitor must carefully choose the events in which he/she will participate after having seen the Schedule tab. Please pay attention to the formats of each round and its respective time limits and cutoffs detailed at the Events tab. It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID. *Competitors who come from outside Lima will have to contact the organizer in order to coordinate the payment method. Registration will stay opened till May 31 or till competitor limit is reached.

items.information: **UPDATE** (March 9): The competition has reached the 60-competitor limit, and a number of people now have registrations on the waiting list. Registration has now been closed. In the event of any cancellation, we will accept people from the waiting list in the order in which they have paid the registration fee. STMHS is holding its first WCA competition in May! This competition is planned to help lower the costs of graduation caps and gowns for seniors in STMHS and bring some love to Connecticut cubing. (And then some!) The events consist of some NxNxN puzzles (2x2 up to 5x5, including 3x3 Blindfolded) as well as more unorthodox puzzles (Skewb, Square-1, Pyraminx). 2x2 and 3x3 will have two rounds while the rest of the events will only have one round. Guests are welcome, though it will be appreciated to inform us on how many each competitor will plan on having with them on their registration forms. To the right of the venue is New London High School which has a free parking lot, though its capacity becoming full throughout the day is unknown.

Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA. REGISTRO: El registro se considera completo cuando se ha completado el registro electrónico y se ha realizado el pago (precio y métodos de pago explicados en la sección de requisitos de registro). Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la pestaña “Horario" (Schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la pestaña “Categorías” (Events). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. *Los competidores que vengan de fuera de Lima deberán comunicarse y coordinar la forma de pago directamente con la tienda Speedcuber Perú al 991817714 o al 7505980. El registro permanecerá abierto hasta el jueves 18 de abril o y hasta que se alcance el límite de competidores. Sin embargo, **solo tendrán derecho a recibir polo quienes completen su registro (inscripción y pago) antes del 06 de abril.**
